English: I see a mother who carries water.
I see a wolf that sees a mother.

Neva: Jaba beres vodrom, vel kapo vodrom.
English: If you carry water, I will have water.

Neva: Bero vodrom kod mathera ne bereth vodrom.
English: I carry water because the mother does not carry water.

Neva: Shos vulkos est mezoteros apo som vulkom.
English: This wolf is bigger than that wolf.
The wolf comes toward the house.
